philosophy: Deterministic financial graphics communicate one exact, verifiable financial relationship at a time.

responsibility.chart_spec: Authoritative for exact values, labels, percentages, ratios, axes, and annotations.
responsibility.illustration: Supports conceptual storytelling but is never authoritative for exact financial data.

principles: Preserve numeric accuracy and declared value semantics.
Use one primary message per chart.
Keep visual density minimal and mobile-legible.
Avoid chartjunk, decorative 3D, and glossy dashboard aesthetics.
Use editorial annotations sparingly to clarify the financial mechanism.
Represent positive and negative meaning semantically, not decoratively.
brand_alignment: Use a warm paper background and deep navy hierarchy.
Use Wealth Decoded gold selectively for emphasis.
Use muted green and red only for positive and negative financial meaning.
Prefer minimal grid lines and an illustrated-book editorial character.
data_rules: Percentage values are percentage points: 15.0 means 15%.
Exact text and numbers are allowed because deterministic graphics own their data.
Sourced facts retain traceable references or remain marked for verification.
Hypothetical and derived values are explicitly classified rather than inferred.
